snippet.title: World of Warcraft: Legion - Patch 7.2 – The Tomb of Sargeras Trailer
snippet.description:
The champions of the Broken Isles prepare to face Kil’jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras. Watch Kil’jaeden’s ire as he looks back at the march of the Burning Legion and all it has meant for his people.

For more information visit: https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/20602170/patch-7-2-the-tomb-of-sargeras-arrives-march-28
